PhD in Mathematics with postdoctoral experience, specializing in ***probability theory, stochastic processes, statistical modeling, and machine learning***.

I have *7 years of Python experience* building predictive models, running simulations, and analyzing complex datasets.

My work includes *risk analysis*, *statistical modeling*, and *machine learning applications* across finance and technology domains using Python (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Pandas), SQL, and R.

Passionate about applying *mathematics to real-world problems*: from risk modeling and data-driven decision-making to game mechanics.
